init_hook: gum style --foreground 212 --border double --border-foreground 212 --padding "1 2" --margin "1" "🎮 PS5 Linux Tools Development Shell"
echo "Welcome! This environment is pre-configured with all build dependencies."
echo "  $(gum style --bold 'build')        : Compiles all tools (ps5_control, m2_init)"
echo "  $(gum style --bold 'build-static') : Compiles all tools statically against libc"
echo "  $(gum style --bold 'install')      : Installs tools and systemd services (requires sudo)"
echo "  $(gum style --bold 'reboot')       : Perform a warm reboot using kexec (requires sudo)"
